item_name: Minimum Training Standards Not Met for the Personal Care Aide
lookback_notes: NOT_FOUND. The protocol's Area 16 states only that training requirements must be met "when services were rendered"; no observation or look-back window in days is stated for this audit area on p. 12.

federal_coding_rules.rule: If the Personal Care Aide did not meet minimum training requirements at the time services were rendered, the claim will be disallowed.

source.quote: If the Personal Care Aide did not meet minimum training requirements when services were rendered, the claim will be disallowed.

federal.criterion: The personnel/training record must establish that the Personal Care Aide met minimum training requirements on the dates services were rendered; otherwise the claim is disallowed.

source.quote: If the Personal Care Aide did not meet minimum training requirements when services were rendered, the claim will be disallowed.

federal.notes: Stated as the OMIG Audit Criteria for Area 16; the specific content of the minimum training requirements is not enumerated in the protocol, only cross-referenced to regulations.
